ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent system analyzing local campus building energy consumption and generating actionable sustainability optimization plans.
ideas.title: Kent Campus Carbon & Energy Audit Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a popular technical architecture from past winning projects with a tangible local institutional application that university judges immediately understand and value.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence dashboard tracking regional Midwest manufacturing suppliers to detect supply chain vulnerabilities and bottlenecks in real time.
ideas.title: Local Supply Chain Graph & Risk Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph-based data modeling which demonstrated strong appeal in previous hackathon wins by providing deep visual analytics rather than simple chat interfaces.

ideas.pitch: A statistical forecasting model predicting campus safety and facility maintenance incidents using historical local data and Poisson regression calibration.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Incident Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and prediction intervals instead of a generic wrapper, echoing strategies that secured 1st place in specialized forecasting competitions.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an everyday problem relevant to student judges, utilizing a polished frontend and personalization flow proven effective in previous wellness hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized micro-task coordination platform where student autonomous agents negotiate and execute campus errands using secure escrow mechanisms.
